app.name: NSCAS
app.tagline: Online measurement of occupational safety and health (OSH) culture maturity

common.resultDisclaimer: These results are an internal measurement and diagnosis that use the Safety Culture Ladder framework as a reference. They are not a Safety Culture Ladder certificate or an official Safety Culture Ladder statement issued by a certification body recognised by NEN.
common.draftBanner: Draft, not yet confirmed by the assessor panel meeting

home.intro: This application is under construction. The assessment console, respondent survey, and reports will be available in later phases.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.intro: Two-step verification protects your account. In addition to your password, you enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone each time you sign in.
security.enabled: Two-step verification has been on since {date}.
security.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.step2: Scan the QR code below with that app.
security.manualKey: If you cannot scan it, enter this key manually:
security.step3: Enter the six-digit code shown in the app.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.backupIntro: Store these ten codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to sign in when your phone is not available. They will not be shown again.
security.regenerateIntro: Once new codes are created, all old backup codes stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.
security.successRegenerated: New backup codes have been created.

units.title: Units
units.intro: Build the unit structure hierarchically, for example head office, divisions, then projects. Project coordinates and radius are used for digital observation.
units.name: Unit name
units.coordinatesHint: Projects only. Example latitude -6.2088 and longitude 106.8456.

strata.title: Strata
strata.intro: Five default strata are prepared from the instrument. Fill in each stratum's population according to the number of workers in scope.
strata.name: Stratum name

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.intro: Default parameters come from the instrument version. Adjust them if needed before the assessment is locked.
parameters.layerWeightsHint: The three weights must add up to 1.00.
parameters.selfAssessmentWeight: Weight of self-assessment within the perception layer
parameters.selfAssessmentHint: Default 0.30, meaning the perception layer is 70 percent survey and 30 percent self-assessment.
parameters.maxAspectBelowLevel: Level consolidation: limit for the lowest aspect index below the level
parameters.maxCharacteristicBelowLevel: Level consolidation: limit for the lowest characteristic index below the level
parameters.perceptionGapAttention: Management and field perception gap needing attention
parameters.assessorDisagreementFlag: Difference between assessor ratings needing reconciliation
parameters.sclTitle: Safety Culture Ladder equivalent track thresholds
parameters.minRespondentsHint: Cannot be lower than 5, in line with the data protection commitment.
parameters.aspectWeightsHint: Aspect weights follow the level 5 maximum points and cannot be changed.
parameters.dpaSigned: The data processing agreement with the client has been signed
parameters.decimalHint: Use a comma or a full stop as the decimal separator, for example 0.35.

sampling.title: Sample calculator
sampling.intro: Sample requirements calculated as in sheet 09 of the workbook. The saved result is a condition for locking the assessment.
sampling.settings: z value {z}, margin of error {e}, proportion {p}, and minimum participation {min} are set on the Parameters page.
sampling.interviewManagement: Minimum interviews with management and staff
sampling.cochranCorrected: Cochran sample with finite population correction
sampling.saved: The calculator result has been saved.
sampling.lastSaved: Result saved at {time} with a survey target of {target} respondents.
sampling.notSaved: The calculator result has not been saved, or is no longer valid because units, strata, or parameters changed.
sampling.noPopulation: Fill in the strata populations first on the Strata page.

formulas.interviewTotal: sum of the two rows above
formulas.recommended: larger of Slovin and corrected Cochran
formulas.stratumTarget: larger of proportion × recommendation and minimum participation × population, at most the population
